name: Katharina Hecht
description: Works on the Ecobuild project, using knowledge graphs to integrate and reason over heterogeneous building-design data in support of sustainable construction decisions. See https://utrechtuniversity.github.io/ecobuild/ for more details.

name: Sjoerd Vink
description: Exploring visual and algorithmic solutions for e.g., large amounts of attributes on nodes/edges in KG, uncertainty in KGs, or query-expansion supporting interfaces; Core research topic with continuous applications in research & BSc/MSc theses.

name: Alister Machado dos Reis
topic: Dimensionality Reduction and Visual Quality Metrics
description: Novel deep learning-based (inverse) projection techniques and measuring the task- and domain-effectiveness of dimensionality reduction algorithms; Continuous applications in research & BSc/MSc theses.

name: Jiao Jiao
description: Data-driven transformation of the energy system. The research was conducted with the research collaborator Fraunhofer ISI (Institut fuer System Innovation) in Germany.

name: Yuncong Yu
topic: Techniques for an Effective and User-guided Exploration of Multivariate Time Series
thesisTitle: Techniques for an Effective and User-guided Exploration of Multivariate Time Series
description: Localized pattern retrieval in multi-track time series with temporal constraints & retrieval invariances. Research topic introduced by external collaboration partner IAV (automobile industry).
